name: Forge
description: An IDE: a folder's files, tabs, search, source control, language servers, a debugger and terminals.

workspace.why: The folder you work in: its files, edited, searched and saved.

programs.shell: The terminal runs your login shell in the folder.
programs.git: The Source Control view reads and changes the folder's repository.
programs.clangd: Completion, diagnostics and navigation in C and C++ files.
programs.lldb-dap: Debugs programs built from C, C++ and Swift.

network.https://id.example.com: Signs in to your account, to sync your settings.
network.ws://127.0.0.1:7420: Syncs your settings through a document server on this computer.

capabilities.files: Imports a color theme you choose.
capabilities.assistant: Answers your questions about your code, with the assistant you set up in Settings.
capabilities.channels: The Agent view talks to the coding agent on this computer, through the host's local socket.
